module.title: cosmic-ray particles (MHD-PIC) and dust
module.expensive_path: the Boris pusher, field interpolation and the MHD-PIC feedback deposit for up to a million particles per step; the 3D Bell instability with CT_CONTACT and 221184 particles is the acceleration workload
module.rationale: the particle module is one code path (injection, pusher, deposit, particle I/O) that couples to the fluid through feedback terms and is selected by PARTICLES in definitions.h
excluded: Lagrangian and dust particle types beyond the CR test problems (no official configurations)
the DUST_FLUID two-fluid module (no official test problem in the pinned tree)
hazards: Bell_Instability seeds its random number generator deterministically (RandomSeed(prank,0)) so runs are reproducible, but the two-rank row depends on the rank layout
particles.NNNN.vtk stores float32; the binary64 particle dumps are the precise contract

approval.human_ref: revise all pluto on main with the latest form from skill/cli, use the cli (2026-09-02); the six modules are the six PLUTO leaves already merged on main (PRs #300, #328 and siblings), unchanged
